event.title: Court Ruling Allows Russia to Compete in Ice Hockey Championships
event.canonical_title: Court Ruling Allows Russia to Compete in Ice Hockey Championships
event.summary: The Court of Arbitration for Sport has ruled that Russian teams must be permitted to participate in international ice hockey tournaments, overturning the IIHF's previous ban imposed due to Russia's invasion of Ukraine. This decision reinstates Russia's eligibility for the 2026-27 season championships.
